Axes: the ordinate is calibrated two-point (x-axis row = 0, top of the y-axis line = 72 umol/min/100 g); the abscissa by least squares on the 19 regular 1-year ticks (66.841 px/year), age 0 on the y-axis column. The four glyphs were matched by normalised cross-correlation against templates cut from clean isolated markers, and detection was constrained to the 29 patient ages printed in Table 1 plus one adult slot, one detection per (patient, glyph). ESTIMATED ERROR +/- 0.3 umol/min/100 g: the 13 adult group means of FIG 2 (all four panels) reproduce the adult column of Table 2 to a mean of +0.03 and a maximum of 0.26 umol/min/100 g. POINTS CONTAINED vs RESOLVED: panel A contains 120 plotted points (4 regions x [29 patients + 1 adult mean]); 101 were individually resolved. The 19 unresolved points are NOT inferred and NOT interpolated - they are absent from the data. They lie in the birth-to-1-year cluster (7 patients across 41 px with 15 px glyphs) and in the 6.7-7.5 y cluster (6 patients across 53 px).
